ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of a book with no last page

plain.li: I was reading at supper, and every time I turned a page the soup got colder and the book got longer.
[quirk:KeepsRecords] Everything I ever wrote down was there on one long scroll, and somebody was reading it back to me aloud.
[quirk:DreamBook] Dreamt I was writing down the dream I was having, and the words got there just ahead of me.
[quirk:ReadsAtMeals] The bowl turned into a book in my hands, and I ate the pages one by one, and they tasted of notes.

warm.li: Last night I read aloud at supper, and the cook let the stew burn rather than miss the end.

blunt.li: A book with no end. Read it all night. Tired.

cheerful.li: In my dream the library had a room for every question, and I had the key to all of them!

gloomy.li: Found the answer on the last page, and then there was another page after it.

cold.li: I read all night and kept one useful fact. I've written it down.

plain.li: Walking past the cells in my dream, and every prisoner we ever held called me by name as I went.
In the dream the cell doors were open and the prisoners were sitting at our table, passing the bread, polite as guests.
Dreamt I was the one behind the bars, and the warden bringing my supper was me as well.

warm.li: The prisoners we let go came back in my dream to say they'd made it home. One of them brought a pie.

blunt.li: Cells dream. Counted them twice. All there.

cheerful.li: Dreamt every prisoner we've ever held joined the colony and we needed a bigger kitchen!

gloomy.li: The cells were full in my dream, and I couldn't remember a single name.

cold.li: I dreamt of the cell block. Every name in order. The mind keeps its own records.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of a coat that mended itself

plain.li: My old coat mended itself in the night, every tear closing up like a wound healing, and it fit like it did the day I got it.
In the dream I was sewing a patch onto the sky where the storm had torn it, with small, even stitches.
Darned a mountain of socks by lamplight, and there was no end to them, and I didn't mind.

warm.li: Dreamt I mended the children's coats while they slept, and in the morning they all went out warm.

blunt.li: Sewed all night in my sleep. Fingers ache.

cheerful.li: The needle threaded itself every time in my dream! Best dream I've had in months.

gloomy.li: Patched a shirt all night, and every patch opened another hole beside it.

cold.li: A dream of repairs. The stitching was very good. Mine usually is.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of drawings that walked

plain.li: The little drawings in my margins climbed off the page and walked around the table on their ink legs.
In the dream every wall in the colony was covered in my doodles, and the others were adding to them.
I drew a door in the corner of a page, and it opened, and there was a room behind it full of better drawings.

warm.li: Dreamt the children found my scribbles and made them into a story. It was a good story.

blunt.li: Drew all night in my sleep. Woke with charcoal on my hands.

cheerful.li: My doodles came to life and the bird one wouldn't stop singing!

gloomy.li: Every drawing I've ever made was in a pile, and someone was feeding them to the fire.

cold.li: I woke with a shape in mind from the dream. I intend to use it.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of smoke under the door

plain.li: Smoke was coming in under the door in my dream, slow and gray, and the others in the room slept on, however hard I shook them.
[quirk:SmokeAversion] The pyre was burning again in the dream, closer this time, right outside my window.
[goal:Firefighter] I put out a fire in my dream, and another started behind me, and another, all the way to the hills.
[child] I smelled smoke in my dream and ran to get the grown-ups, but my legs went slow.

warm.li: Carried the others out of a burning house in my dream, one at a time. I got them all, but I woke up shaking.

blunt.li: Smoke dream. Got up and checked the fires. Banked.

cheerful.li: Dreamt of smoke, woke up, and it was only the cook burning the porridge. I've never been so glad of burnt porridge!

gloomy.li: The smoke again. One of these nights it won't be a dream.

cold.li: A dream of a fire I couldn't find. I checked the hearths on waking. All in order.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of the hour before dawn

plain.li: The sun came up three times in my dream, and each time I was the only one there to see it.
[quirk:LateHours] The night went on and on, and I got everything done, every job in the colony, and still it wasn't morning.
[quirk:SleepTalker] Dreamt I was talking in my sleep, and somebody was writing it all down, and it made perfect sense.
[quirk:EarlyRiser] I got up before dawn in my dream and found the sun still asleep behind the hill, and had to wake it.

warm.li: In the dream I sat up with someone who couldn't sleep, and we watched the light come over the fields together.

blunt.li: Dreamt about not sleeping. Then didn't.

cheerful.li: Dreamt there was an extra hour in the day and I got to choose where it went! I put it after breakfast.

gloomy.li: A dream of the gray hour, when the fires are low and the cold creeps in. I know it too well.

cold.li: The hours were badly arranged in my dream. I'd have ordered them differently.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of things that wouldn't stay counted

plain.li: Counting sacks in the storeroom all night, and every time I reached the end the first one had moved.
[quirk:TidyTable] I swept the hall in my dream and the dust came back in through the cracks as fast as I swept it out.
[quirk:CountsCoins] A trader paid me in coins that turned to buttons every time I looked away.
[quirk:CountsThings] The steps up to the door were a different number every time I climbed them.

warm.li: I counted heads at supper in my dream, and the number was right, and then there was one more, and it was someone I'd missed.

blunt.li: Counted things all night. Lost count. Annoyed.

cheerful.li: Everything in the storeroom lined up in neat rows in my dream, and it all added up!

gloomy.li: The numbers wouldn't come out right however many times I tried. They never do.

cold.li: Inventory, all night. The discrepancy was never explained.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of the made thing

plain.li: A piece of wood in my hands, and the knife knew where to go, and a heron came out of it.
[quirk:MeasuresTwice] Built a wall in my dream where every stone fit the first time, and the line was straight as a held breath.
[quirk:PrettyStones] I found a stone in my dream that held the whole sky inside it, blue and moving.
[quirk:MarksWork] In the dream I saw my mark on things all over the world, in houses I've never been to.

warm.li: Dreamt I carved a little thing for each of them, a bird, a spoon, a button, each one right for its owner.

blunt.li: Made a fine piece in my sleep. Can't remember how.

cheerful.li: I carved a whole menagerie in my dream, and the little goat kept walking off the shelf!

gloomy.li: Made the best thing I've ever made, in the dream. Woke up with empty hands.

cold.li: The joint fit perfectly in my dream. I'm going to try the same cut today.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of a load that kept growing

plain.li: Carrying a sack up a hill in my dream, and every few steps someone handed me another, and I kept taking them.
[quirk:Fidgets] They made me lie still in the dream, so I ran in place under the blanket all night.
[quirk:Volunteers] Every time someone asked for a pair of hands, mine went up, until I had a dozen of them.

warm.li: Dreamt I carried the others' loads to the top of the hill, and at the top they were all waiting to carry me back down.

blunt.li: Hauled all night. Woke up tired. Typical.

cheerful.li: Dreamt I could carry the whole storeroom on my back, and it felt like nothing at all!

gloomy.li: The load got heavier and heavier, and I kept smiling so they wouldn't ask.

cold.li: Too much cargo, in the dream. I've reconsidered how much I carry.

plain.li: In the dream I tended a cut that closed under my fingers as I watched, neat as a seam.
[quirk:HealersSalve] The healer came back in my dream to show me the rest of the salve, and I wrote down every leaf.
[quirk:SteadyHands] My hands didn't shake once in the dream, not even with the knife, not even with the patient's family watching.

warm.li: Dreamt the people I've tended came by one after another to show me their scars, all healed clean.

blunt.li: Stitched wounds all night. Steady. Good.

cheerful.li: In my dream I had a salve for everything, even bad moods! I rubbed it on the cook.

gloomy.li: There was a wound in my dream that wouldn't close, however much I pressed on it.

cold.li: A dream of surgery. Clean, careful, uneventful. As it should be.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of a long table

plain.li: The table in my dream went on past the end of the hall, and everyone I've ever eaten with had a seat at it.
[quirk:Birthdays] It was everyone's birthday at once in my dream, and I remembered every one, and there was a cake for each.
[quirk:BestBiteLast] I saved the best bite for last in my dream, and the plate kept filling up so I never had to eat it.
[quirk:Juggles] I juggled at the table in my dream and nothing fell, not the spoons, not the bowls, not the cook's good knife.
[quirk:Hums|quirk:SingsAtStove] The whole valley was humming my tune in the dream, at the stove and in the fields and at the table.
[quirk:WrongLaugh] I laughed at the wrong moment in my dream, and this time everybody laughed with me.

warm.li: Dreamt of supper with all of us there, the lamps lit late and the plates long empty.

blunt.li: Big supper in my dream. Good food. Woke hungry.

cheerful.li: The supper in my dream had music, a cake as tall as the door, and the dishes washed themselves!

gloomy.li: A long table in my dream, full of people, and a few of the chairs I knew should be empty.

cold.li: Well provisioned, well attended, entirely imaginary. Still, a pleasant meal.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of tracks in new snow

plain.li: Fresh snow in my dream, and a line of tracks across it I'd never seen, and I followed them to the edge of the map.
[quirk:FeelsTheCold] I was cold in my dream, so cold, and then somebody put a hot stone in my hands and I could feel my fingers again.
[quirk:ColdTrick] The traveler who taught me the trick was walking ahead of me in the snow, and I matched every step.
[quirk:KnowsTrails] I knew every trail in the dream, every bent stalk and scuffed stone, and they all led home.

warm.li: We were all out in the snow in my dream, warm as toast, and the children were throwing it at each other.

blunt.li: Snow and tracks. Followed them. Woke up.

cheerful.li: I tracked a hare in my dream, and when I caught up with it, it said good morning!

gloomy.li: The tracks went into the trees in my dream, and stopped, and I didn't want to know why.

cold.li: I noted which way the tracks went in my dream. Probably meaningless.

plain.li: Every door in the colony had a line of salt across it in my dream, and something outside was reading them.
[quirk:LuckyItem] I lost my lucky thing in the dream, and found it again on someone else, and they wouldn't give it back.
[quirk:RedLuck] Everyone at the table was dressed in red in my dream, and I was the only one who seemed to mind.
[quirk:KnocksWood] Knocked on wood in my dream, and something knocked back.
[quirk:EclipseDread] The sun went out in my dream, slow, like a lamp turned down, and the others went on with their work.

warm.li: Dreamt I tied a charm over every door in the colony, and nothing bad came through any of them all year.

blunt.li: Bad-luck dream. Did all the right things this morning. Twice.

cheerful.li: In my dream every sign was a good one, even the crow on the roof, who only wanted bread!

gloomy.li: The signs were all there in my dream, plain as day, and I still couldn't stop what came after.

cold.li: A dream of omens. I don't believe in them. I took the usual precautions anyway.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of the long watch

plain.li: I walked the wall all night in my dream, and every time I came round to the gate it was a little further away.
[quirk:SharpensBlades] Sharpened a blade in my dream until it could cut the dark, and then I cut a door in it.
[quirk:BattleRitual] I did the ritual before the fight in my dream, every step, and the fight never came.

warm.li: Dreamt I kept watch so well that the children slept through till morning and woke up rested.

blunt.li: On watch all night. In my sleep. Still tired.

cheerful.li: Dreamt the raiders saw how sharp my knife was and turned right round!

gloomy.li: The watch never ends, in the dream or out of it.

cold.li: Guard duty in my sleep. Nothing happened, which is the best kind of watch.

plain.li: I said the night prayer like always, and in the dream {LOST} said the last line with me.
[quirk:TalksToDead] I talk to {LOST} at the grave most days. Last night, in the dream, {LOST} answered.
[quirk:ExtraPlace] The place I set at the table for {LOST} was taken in my dream, and the plate was empty when I looked again.
[quirk:WinterGrief] Snow in my dream, deep and blue, and {LOST} walking through it toward me, leaving no tracks.
[quirk:RainCleanses] I stood in the rain in my dream, and {LOST} came and stood beside me, and neither of us went in.
[story:LongGrief] {LOST} sat with me in the dream and let me say everything I'd been saving, and then asked how the garden was doing.

warm.li: {LOST} came in my dream to tell me they'd heard every word I've said to them. Every single one.

blunt.li: {LOST} answered, in my dream. Didn't say much. Enough.

cheerful.li: {LOST} laughed at my jokes in the dream, the way they always did, even the bad ones.

gloomy.li: {LOST} answered me last night. It was only a dream. I'm keeping it anyway.

cold.li: I dreamt that {LOST} replied. The mind supplies what it lacks. I don't object.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of a lamp on the road

plain.li: From far out on the road in my dream I could see our lamp in the window, small and steady, and I walked toward it all night.
[quirk:RoadStories] Every road I've ever walked was laid out in my dream like a map on the table, and I could point to each town.
[quirk:LampForTravelers] Travelers came up the road by the light of my lamp in the dream, one after another, and each one knew my name.
[child] I dreamt my candle was so bright people saw it from the next valley.

warm.li: In my dream every traveler on the road found a lit window that night, not only ours.

blunt.li: Lamp dream. Road was busy. Nice.

cheerful.li: Dreamt the whole road was lined with lamps, all the way to the sea, and I'd lit every one!

gloomy.li: I kept the lamp burning all night in my dream, and the road stayed empty till dawn.

cold.li: A dream of the road at night. The lamp did what it's for.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: the dream of the travelers at the lamp

plain.li: Dreamt of strangers coming up the road in the dark, following our lamp, and one of them carried a lantern with a green glass.
In the dream I heard boots on the road and voices, and I went out with the lamp, and there they were, tired and glad of us.
People were standing at the gate in my dream, under the lamp, waiting to be let in. Friendly. I'm sure they were friendly.

warm.li: Guests are coming. I dreamt them. I'm going to air out the spare beds.

blunt.li: Visitors coming. Dreamt it. Trim the lamp.

cheerful.li: Visitors in my dream, lots of them, and they brought news and a fiddle!

gloomy.li: Strangers on the road in my dream, under my lamp. I hope I lit it for the right people.

cold.li: I dreamt of arrivals on the road. I'll keep watch on it for the next few days.
